title: Asus Vivobook 16X - Laptop freezes after suspend/hibernate
body: My laptop (model K3605VV) is unable to resume from any of the sleep states that are available. After the I close the lid and open it, the screen stays black although the keyboard backlight is on. I cannot switch to a tty either. I have just updated to the latest Arch kernel (although not the problem with Kernel). I have dual graphics: Intel Iris Xe and NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060. I have disabled NVIDIA however the problem persists with/without it. $ uname -r 6.7.2-arch1-1 The system advertises the following sleep states: $ cat /sys/power/mem_sleep [s2idle] deep None of them work. Hibernation and standby (S1 sleep) don't work either.
